chapter.li: LEChapter7 Verse1 And now I, Moroni, write a few of the words of my father, Mormon, which he spake concerning faith, hope, and charity, for after this manner did he speak unto the people as he taught them in the synagogue which they had built for the place of worship: VerseEnd

Verse2 And now I, Mormon, speak unto 2PP you, my beloved brethren. And it is by the grace of God the Father and our Lord Jesus Christ and his holy will, because of the gift of his calling unto me, that I am permitted to speak unto 2PP you at this time. VerseEnd Verse3 Wherefore, I would speak unto 2PP you that are of the church, that are the peaceable followers of Christ, and that have obtained a sufficient hope by which 2PP ye can enter into the rest of the Lord, from this time henceforth, until 2PP ye shall rest with him in Heaven. VerseEnd Verse4 And now, my brethren, I judge these things of 2PP you because of 2PP your peaceable walk with the children of men. VerseEnd Verse5 For I remember the word of God which saith, By their works, 2PP ye shall know them. For if their works be good, then they are good also. VerseEnd Verse6 For behold, God hath said, A man being evil cannot do that which is good; for if he offereth a gift or prayeth unto God, except he shall do it with real intent, it profiteth him nothing. VerseEnd Verse7 For behold, it is not counted unto him for righteousness. VerseEnd Verse8 For behold, if a man being evil giveth a gift, he doeth it grudgingly; wherefore, it is counted unto him the same as if he had retained the gift. Wherefore, he is counted evil before God. VerseEnd Verse9 And likewise, also is it counted evil unto a man if he shall pray and not with real intent of heart. Yea, and it profiteth him nothing, for God receiveth none such. VerseEnd Verse10 Wherefore, a man being evil cannot do that which is good, neither will he give a good gift. VerseEnd Verse11 For behold, a bitter fountain cannot bring forth good water, neither can a good fountain bring forth bitter water. Wherefore, a man being the servant of the Devil cannot follow Christ; and if he follow Christ, he cannot be a servant of the Devil. VerseEnd Verse12 Wherefore, all things which are good cometh of God, and that which is evil cometh of the Devil. For the Devil is an enemy unto God, and fighteth against him continually, and inviteth and enticeth to sin, and to do that which is evil continually. VerseEnd Verse13 But behold, that which is of God inviteth and enticeth to do good continually.

Wherefore, everything which inviteth and enticeth to do good, and to love God, and to serve him, is inspired of God. VerseEnd Verse14 Wherefore, take heed, my beloved brethren, that 2PP ye do not judge that which is evil to be of God, or that which is good and of God to be of the Devil. VerseEnd Verse15 For behold, my brethren, it is given unto 2PP you to judge, that 2PP ye may know good from evil. And the way to judge is as plain, that 2PP ye may know with a perfect knowledge as the daylight is from the dark night. VerseEnd Verse16 For behold, the spirit of Christ is given to every man, that they may know good from evil. Wherefore, I shew unto 2PP you the way to judge. For everything which inviteth to do good and to persuade to believe in Christ is sent forth by the power and gift of Christ. Wherefore, 2PP ye may know with a perfect knowledge it is of God. VerseEnd Verse17 But whatsoever thing persuadeth men to do evil, and believe not in Christ, and deny him, and serve not God, then 2PP ye may know with a perfect knowledge it is of the Devil, for after this manner doth the Devil work; for he persuadeth no man to do good, no not one, neither doth his angels, neither do they who subject themselves unto him. VerseEnd Verse18 And now, my brethren, seeing that 2PP ye know the light by which 2PP ye may judge, which light is the light of Christ, see that 2PP ye do not judge wrongfully; for with that same judgment which 2PP ye judge, 2PP ye shall also be judged. VerseEnd Verse19 Wherefore, I beseech of 2PP you, brethren, that 2PP ye should search diligently in the light of Christ that 2PP ye may know good from evil. And if 2PP ye will lay hold upon every good thing and condemn it not, 2PP ye certainly will be a child of Christ. VerseEnd

Verse20 And now my brethren, how is it possible that 2PP ye can lay hold upon every good thing? VerseEnd Verse21 And now I come to that faith of which I said I would speak, and I will tell 2PP you the way whereby 2PP ye may lay hold on every good thing. VerseEnd Verse22 For behold, God knowing all things, being from everlasting to everlasting, behold, he sent angels to minister unto the children of men, to make manifest concerning the coming of Christ, and in Christ there should come every good thing. VerseEnd Verse23 And God also declared unto prophets by his own mouth that Christ should come. VerseEnd Verse24 And behold, there were divers ways that he did manifest things unto the children of men which were good, and all things which are good cometh of Christ; otherwise, men were fallen and there could no good thing come unto them. VerseEnd Verse25 Wherefore, by the ministering of angels and by every word which proceeded forth out of the mouth of God, men began to exercise faith in Christ; and thus by faith they did lay hold upon every good thing, and thus it was until the coming of Christ; VerseEnd Verse26 and after that he came, men also were saved by faith in his name. And by faith they become the sons of God.

And as sure as Christ liveth, he spake these words unto our fathers, saying, Whatsoever thing 2PP ye shall ask the Father in my name, which is good, in faith, believing that 2PP ye shall receive, behold, it shall be done unto 2PP you. VerseEnd Verse27 Wherefore, my beloved brethren, hath miracles ceased because Christ hath ascended into Heaven? And hath sit down on the right hand of God to claim of the Father his rights of mercy which he hath upon the children of men? VerseEnd Verse28 For he hath answered the ends of the law, and he claimeth all those that have faith in him; and they that have faith in him will cleave unto every good thing. Wherefore, he advocateth the cause of the children of men. And he dwelleth eternally in the Heavens. VerseEnd

Verse29 And because he hath done this, my beloved brethren, hath miracles ceased? Behold, I say unto 2PP you, nay; neither have angels ceased to minister unto the children of men. VerseEnd Verse30 For behold, they are subject unto him, to minister according to the word of his command, shewing themselves unto them of strong faith and a firm mind in every form of godliness. VerseEnd Verse31 And the office of their ministry is to call men unto repentance, and to fulfill and to do the work of the covenants of the Father which he hath made unto the children of men, to prepare the way among the children of men by declaring the word of Christ unto the chosen vessels of the Lord, that they may bear testimony of him; VerseEnd Verse32 and by so doing, the Lord God prepareth the way that the residue of men may have faith in Christ, that the holy ghost may have place in their hearts, according to the power thereof; and after this manner bringeth to pass the Father the covenants which he hath made unto the children of men. VerseEnd Verse33 And Christ hath said, If 2PP ye will have faith in me, 2PP ye shall have power to do whatsoever thing is expedient in me. VerseEnd Verse34 And he hath said, Repent, all 2PP ye ends of the earth, and come unto me, and be baptized in my name, and have faith in me, that 2PP ye may be saved. VerseEnd

Verse35 And now, my beloved brethren, if this be the case, that these things are true which I have spoken unto 2PP you — and God will shew unto 2PP you with power and great glory at the last day that they are true — and if they are true, have the day of miracles ceased? VerseEnd Verse36 Or have angels ceased to appear unto the children of men? Or has he withheld the power of the holy ghost from them? Or will he so long as time shall last, or the earth shall stand, or there shall be one man upon the face thereof to be saved? VerseEnd Verse37 Behold, I say unto 2PP you, nay. For it is by faith that miracles are wrought, and it is by faith that angels appear and minister unto men. Wherefore, if these things have ceased, woe be unto the children of men, for it is because of unbelief, and all is vain. VerseEnd Verse38 For no man can be saved, according to the words of Christ, save they shall have faith in his name. Wherefore, if these things have ceased, then has faith ceased also, and awful is the state of man, for they are as though there had been no redemption made. VerseEnd

Verse39 But behold, my beloved brethren, I judge better things of 2PP you, for I judge that 2PP ye have faith in Christ, because of 2PP your meekness; for if 2PP ye have not faith in him, then 2PP ye are not fit to be numbered among the people of his church. VerseEnd Verse40 And again, my beloved brethren, I would speak unto 2PP you concerning hope. How is it that 2PP ye can attain unto faith save 2PP ye shall have hope? VerseEnd Verse41 And what is it that 2PP ye shall hope for? Behold, I say unto 2PP you that 2PP ye shall have hope through the atonement of Christ and the power of his resurrection to be raised unto life eternal, and this because of 2PP your faith in him, according to the promise. VerseEnd Verse42 Wherefore, if a man have faith, he must needs have hope; for without faith, there cannot be any hope. VerseEnd Verse43 And again, behold, I say unto 2PP you that he cannot have faith and hope save he shall be meek and lowly of heart. VerseEnd Verse44 If so, his faith and hope is vain, for none is acceptable before God save the meek and lowly of heart.

And if a man be meek and lowly in heart, and confesses by the power of the holy ghost that Jesus is the Christ, he must needs have charity. For if he have not charity, he is nothing; wherefore, he must needs have charity. VerseEnd Verse45 And charity suffereth long, and is kind, and envieth not, and is not puffed up, seeketh not her own, is not easily provoked, thinketh no evil, and rejoiceth not in iniquity, but rejoiceth in the truth, beareth all things, believeth all things, hopeth all things, endureth all things. VerseEnd Verse46 Wherefore, my beloved brethren, if 2PP ye have not charity, 2PP ye are nothing, for charity never faileth. Wherefore, cleave unto charity, which is the greatest of all. For all things must fail, VerseEnd Verse47 but charity is the pure love of Christ, and it endureth for ever. And whoso is found possessed of it at the last day, it shall be well with them. VerseEnd Verse48 Wherefore, my beloved brethren, pray unto the Father with all the energy of heart that 2PP ye may be filled with this love, which he hath bestowed upon all who are true followers of his Son Jesus Christ; that 2PP ye may become the sons of God; that when he shall appear, we shall be like him, for we shall see him as he is; that we may have this hope; that we may be purified, even as he is pure. Amen. VerseEnd
